note: Light trigger check set: should-trigger phrasings about a company the user runs, across announcements, media relations, messaging and crisis work, and near-miss negatives that a neighbouring skill owns. Used by the description trigger check.
should_trigger: write a press release announcing our seed round
how should we announce our new CEO to the press and to the team
pitch our product launch to a few tech reporters
a journalist emailed asking about our layoffs, what do we say
prep me for my interview with a trade magazine about our company next week
we need a holding statement now, a customer says our app leaked their data and it is spreading online
build a messaging house for our startup
give our spokespeople the lines for questions about the product recall
draft a crisis communications plan for our company before we launch
put together the press kit for our launch
what should we say publicly about yesterday's outage
plan who hears about our acquisition first, and when

near_miss.query: proofread this press release for typos, the wording is already approved
write a LinkedIn post about my promotion
write the release notes for version 2.4 of this library
plan the marketing campaign and ad budget for our launch
sharpen our product positioning against our competitors
reply to this customer who is angry about a late refund
check this statement for defamation and liability risk before we publish it
draft the breach notice the data protection regulator requires
should our company take a public stand on the new regulation or stay out of it
research how the press covered our competitor's data breach last year
make a chart of our user growth for the press kit
